schema.employees: array — one entry per employee, in execution order: key, name, status (SUCCESS, FAILED, NOT_EXECUTABLE, SKIPPED_DEPENDENCY_FAILED), attempts, durationSeconds, error, outputs
schema.failures: array — employees with status FAILED this run, for 09-CEO-Advisor to read as candidate actions (see decision-model.md)
schema.reportPath: string — this run's Daily Execution Report, relative to the repo root
schema.logPath: string — this run's full log, relative to the repo root
